description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired). Generalized CLASS of the P304 centrifuge M-04 miss: within ONE contract, some state-mutating functions guard a beneficiary param with an owner-tied check (a withApproval(owner) modifier / require(msg.sender==owner)) while SIBLING functions take a beneficiary param of the same role UNGUARDED -> a third party can act for the beneficiary (deposit/claim-for-others griefing/DoS). Two-signal: S1 the contract has >=1 owner-guarded beneficiary function (establishes the intended guard); S2 a sibling beneficiary function is external + state-mutating + NOT owner-guarded + NOT admin-access-controlled. Suppress: views; admin-guarded (auth/onlyX) functions; contracts with no owner-guarded sibling (a uniformly permissionless vault has no asymmetry). Anchor: centrifuge LiquidityPool.deposit/mint (unguarded receiver) vs requestDeposit/withdraw/redeem (withApproval(owner)). Does NOT assert exploitability — flags the guard asymmetry surface.

fp_controls.two_signal_required: S1 a sibling owner-guarded beneficiary function exists AND S2 this beneficiary function is external + state-mutating + neither owner-guarded nor admin-access-controlled.
fp_controls.no_guarded_sibling_suppression: a contract that never owner-guards a beneficiary param (a uniformly permissionless vault) -> no asymmetry -> silent.
fp_controls.admin_guard_suppression: functions carrying an admin modifier (auth/onlyGateway/onlyRole/...) are access-controlled, not an open beneficiary surface -> suppressed.
